import primitive_api as api

ctx = api.get_task_context()
obs = api.inspect_current_view(label="start_view", remember=True)
scan = api.scan_scene(
    queries=["Egg", "Fridge", "Microwave", "StoveBurner", "CounterTop", "SinkBasin", "Sponge"],
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)
prog = api.check_progress_public()

print("TASK:", ctx)
print("INIT POSE:", obs["observation"]["agent"])
print("QUERY HITS:", {k: len(v) for k, v in scan["query_hits"].items()})
for k, v in scan["query_hits"].items():
    print("HIT", k, [(o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance"), o.get("position")) for o in v[:5]])
print("PROGRESS:", prog)

import primitive_api as api

# In start_view, we are facing z- (rot y=180). The stove is on the left (x+), table on the right (x-).
# Let's move ahead toward the wall (z-) by 4-5 steps, then check our surroundings (to the left x+ near the stove/counter, and to the right x- for the fridge).
for i in range(6):
    res = api.move_ahead()
    print(f"move {i+1}:", res.get("ok", res.get("success")), api.observe()["agent"])
    if not res.get("ok", res.get("success", True)):
        break

# Rotate left (to face x+, where the counter beyond the stove is)
api.rotate("left")
v1 = api.inspect_current_view(label="face_counter_near_wall", remember=True)
print("Facing x+ visible:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v1["visible_objects"]])

# Also check if we need to look up or if Egg is visible
eggs = api.detect_objects("Egg")
print("Eggs facing x+:", eggs)

# Rotate 180 (left twice) to face x- (towards fridge?)
api.rotate("left")
api.rotate("left")
v2 = api.inspect_current_view(label="face_x_minus", remember=True)
print("Facing x- visible:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v2["visible_objects"]])

import primitive_api as api

# Egg|-01.19|+00.94|+01.45 is visible right now at distance 1.187!
egg_id = "Egg|-01.19|+00.94|+01.45"
res_pick = api.pickup_object(egg_id)
print("Pickup Egg directly:", res_pick)
print("Inventory:", api.query_inventory())

# If direct pickup failed (e.g. out of reach or angle), approach or step closer around the table:
if not api.query_inventory():
    # We are at (0.0, 1.5) facing x- (270). The table is at z~1.32, Egg is at (-1.185, 1.45).
    # Let's rotate right (to face z+ = 0 deg), move 2 steps to z=2.0, rotate left (face x- = 270), move 3-4 steps to x=-0.75 or -1.0, rotate left (face z- = 180)
    api.rotate("right") # rot 0 (z+)
    api.move_ahead() # z=1.75
    api.move_ahead() # z=2.0
    api.rotate("left") # rot 270 (x-)
    api.move_ahead() # x=-0.25
    api.move_ahead() # x=-0.5
    api.move_ahead() # x=-0.75
    api.move_ahead() # x=-1.0
    api.rotate("left") # rot 180 (z-)
    v = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_table_north", remember=True)
    print("At table north pose:", v["observation"]["agent"])
    print("Visible at table north:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v["visible_objects"]])
    res_pick2 = api.pickup_object(egg_id)
    print("Pickup Egg from north of table:", res_pick2)
    print("Inventory after north try:", api.query_inventory())

# Let's also check where the Fridge is from our current position by looking up / rotating right (facing x- = 270)
api.look("up")
v_up = api.inspect_current_view(label="look_up_check", remember=True)
print("Visible looking up:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v_up["visible_objects"]])
api.rotate("right")
v_west = api.inspect_current_view(label="face_west_fridge", remember=True)
print("Visible facing west:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v_west["visible_objects"]])

import primitive_api as api

# We have the Egg in inventory! And in `look_up_check_c27307f35a.png`, the Fridge is directly ahead (west, x-) just north of the DiningTable!
# Currently we rotated right to rot=0 (facing z+ north), at x=0.0, z=1.5, horizon=15.
print("Current pose:", api.observe()["agent"])
print("Recalled Fridge:", api.recall_visible_objects("Fridge"))

# Let's step north (z+) 3 steps to z=2.25, then rotate left to face west (x-, rot=270), where the Fridge is!
api.move_ahead() # z=1.75
api.move_ahead() # z=2.0
api.move_ahead() # z=2.25
api.rotate("left") # rot=270 (facing west x-)
v_f1 = api.inspect_current_view(label="facing_fridge_far", remember=True)
print("Pose at z=2.25 facing west:", v_f1["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible at z=2.25 facing west:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v_f1["visible_objects"]])

# Move ahead toward the fridge (say 2-3 steps, stop around x=-0.75 or -1.0 so we have room to open the fridge door)
api.move_ahead() # x=-0.25
api.move_ahead() # x=-0.5
api.move_ahead() # x=-0.75
v_f2 = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_fridge", remember=True)
print("Pose at fridge:", v_f2["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible at fridge:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in v_f2["visible_objects"]])

fridges = api.detect_objects("Fridge")
print("Detected Fridges:", fridges)
if fridges:
    fridge_id = fridges[0]["objectId"]
    egg_id = api.query_inventory()[0]["objectId"]
    r_open = api.open_object(fridge_id)
    print("Open fridge:", r_open)
    r_put = api.put_object(egg_id, fridge_id)
    print("Put egg in fridge:", r_put)
    r_close1 = api.close_object(fridge_id)
    print("Close fridge 1:", r_close1)
    r_open2 = api.open_object(fridge_id)
    print("Open fridge 2:", r_open2)
    r_pick = api.pickup_object(egg_id)
    print("Pick cooled egg:", r_pick)
    r_close2 = api.close_object(fridge_id)
    print("Close fridge 2:", r_close2)
    print("Inventory after fridge:", api.query_inventory())
    print("Progress after fridge:", api.check_progress_public())

import primitive_api as api

# At x=-0.75, distance to Fridge|-02.64|+00.00|+02.13 is 2.1m (too far to open; THOR max reach is 1.5m).
# Let's check why r_open failed and step closer (say 2-3 steps ahead to x=-1.25 or -1.5, where distance ~ 1.4-1.6m).
print("r_open error:", r_open.get("observation_after", {}).get("errorMessage"))

for i in range(2):
    api.move_ahead() # x=-1.0, x=-1.25
obs = api.observe()
print("Pose now:", obs["agent"])
print("Fridge dist now:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["isOpen"]) for o in obs["visible_objects"] if o["objectType"] == "Fridge"])

fridge_id = "Fridge|-02.64|+00.00|+02.13"
egg_id = "Egg|-01.19|+00.94|+01.45"

r_open = api.open_object(fridge_id)
print("open at x=-1.25:", r_open["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_open["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
if not r_open["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"]:
    # If too far, move ahead 1 step to x=-1.5; if blocked by door, we can adjust z
    api.move_ahead()
    print("Pose at x=-1.5:", api.observe()["agent"])
    r_open = api.open_object(fridge_id)
    print("open at x=-1.5:", r_open["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_open["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])

if r_open["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"]:
    r_put = api.put_object(egg_id, fridge_id)
    print("put:", r_put["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_put["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
    r_close1 = api.close_object(fridge_id)
    print("close1:", r_close1["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_close1["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
    r_open2 = api.open_object(fridge_id)
    print("open2:", r_open2["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_open2["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
    r_pick = api.pickup_object(egg_id)
    print("pick:", r_pick["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_pick["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
    r_close2 = api.close_object(fridge_id)
    print("close2:", r_close2["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_close2["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])

print("Inventory:", api.query_inventory())
print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())

import primitive_api as api

# Goal condition 1/3 is met (Egg is cold)!
# Now we need to put the cold egg in the microwave: Microwave|-01.53|+01.25|+03.88
# We are currently at x=-1.25, z=2.25, rot=270 (facing west).
# Let's rotate right (rot=0, facing north z+) and walk toward z=3.0 (3 steps), where we'll be right in front of the Sink/Microwave!
api.rotate("right") # rot=0 (north z+)
for i in range(3):
    api.move_ahead() # z=2.5, 2.75, 3.0

obs = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_microwave", remember=True)
print("Pose at microwave:", obs["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible at microwave:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["isOpen"]) for o in obs["visible_objects"]])

mw_id = "Microwave|-01.53|+01.25|+03.88"
egg_id = "Egg|-01.19|+00.94|+01.45"

# If Microwave isn't visible (e.g. slightly higher or lower horizon), look up
if not any(o["objectId"] == mw_id for o in obs["visible_objects"]):
    api.look("up")
    obs = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_microwave_up", remember=True)
    print("Visible after look up:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["isOpen"]) for o in obs["visible_objects"]])

r_open = api.open_object(mw_id)
print("Open microwave:", r_open["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_open["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
r_put = api.put_object(egg_id, mw_id)
print("Put egg in microwave:", r_put["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_put["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])
r_close = api.close_object(mw_id)
print("Close microwave:", r_close["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r_close["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])

print("Check success:", api.check_success())
print("Check progress public:", api.check_progress_public())
